name: domo-backfill-codigos
description: One-shot, idempotent migration that backfills codigos/{CODE} lookup docs for casas that predate the join-by-code lookup. Standalone Node harness, NOT part of the Flutter app's pubspec, and NOT part of test/rules. Requires the Admin SDK (a service-account key) — see scripts/backfill/README.md and docs/DEPLOY.md before running.
